review.reviewBasis: All 426 pairs visually inspected on the actual 24 paired contact sheets, including the final Northeast 8th/9th Street and ramp views. Images were not inferred from integrity checks.

findings.note: Orange closure/bollard/edge walls are visible at game-map ends. They are game boundary markers, not evidence of actual street closures; final comparison records must retain this limitation.
Generic facade materials/bay counts/planting and signs remain visibly simplified. Source coverage/topology checks do not establish photographic identity.
Older imagery predates the frozen2026source snapshot. No source body was removed or moved to fit older reference imagery.

findings.classification: Reference date and source vertical uncertainty
findings.note: Older2018reference imagery shows an earlier site configuration than the current source snapshot. Current source masses and estimated grade are retained; the two overlapping source-surface camera ambiguities are explicitly flagged.

findings.scope: Bellevue Way commercial frontage and source skybridges
findings.note: The existing source-scoped landmark volumes, broad skybridge connections and source business identities are present. Facade colours, storefront architecture, detailed entrances, street planting and individual signs remain visibly simplified. This review does not establish photographic identity.

findings: Poses 201–275 manually inspected on paired sheets 012–016. Northeast 8th Street bridge and downtown street walls retain simplified facade/planting/sign detail; overlapping elevated-source camera ambiguity remains flagged. Current source geometry is not changed from Google comparisons.

All 22 flagged elevation ambiguities were inspected. Several I-405/NE8th reference panoramas lie beneath a crossing while the retained sampled source way is an elevated deck. Google metadata supplies no altitude; these remain uncertain comparisons, without road-layer or camera relocation claims.

metadataSurvey.scope: Compiled public drivable nonvirtual, nontunnel source streets excluding service, motorway, motorway_link and trunk_link; length greater than 4 m. Sampling is along both sides, with facade and along-street headings. Private airfield, indoor and full nearby-ring street coverage are not claimed.
metadataSurvey.altitude: Panorama metadata does not provide altitude. Source road-layer and estimated grade selection is retained per pose; overlapping elevations and off-ribbon panoramas remain flagged.
metadataSurvey.use: Google Street View is used for comparison only. No reference imagery, copyright strings or extracted scene attributes are published.

sourceIdentityValidation.note: Original source identities are recovered from the exact sampled road-centre coordinate, not a nearest panorama or nearby building.
